chips.title: Implement production audit tiers
chips.summary: Audit selection, queueing, imports, release gates and full audit scheduling are implemented.

evidence.message: Recorded from the implemented plan and its existing acceptance tests.

chips.title: Verify production audit readiness
chips.summary: Check live audit configuration, waiting jobs and release prerequisites; record the next safe activation step.

evidence.message: Selected because the prior handoff reports inactive tiers and waiting imports.
Board and status passed the Dias parsers; live readiness inspection started.
Verified live policy, stored audits and service health; recorded activation prerequisites and the GitLab access failure.

chips.title: Recover GitLab reader access
chips.summary: Diagnose the provider authentication failure and restore reconciliation without hiding route coverage.

evidence.message: Live reconciliation returns HTTP 401 while the worker is running; credential cause is not yet established.
The operator reported saving a replacement after GitLab confirmed that the original reader had expired. Live verification started.
The replacement read the project and pipeline jobs and fetched the branch. GitLab denied the job log because the reader lacks Job Read.
The worker can read the original vault entry only. It restarted on that entry. The operator must save a reader with job log access there.
The operator reported updating the original vault entry. Verification resumed from the worker host.
The worker host read the previously rejected job log and fetched the main branch at the revision reported by GitLab.
Both providers reconciled after the worker restarted. Health reported zero problems and the alert service accepted the resolution.

chips.title: Settle three waiting pull request audits
chips.summary: Review the saved audit packets for three merged pull requests. Import valid reports or record why an obsolete audit was cancelled.

evidence.message: The live queue still has three pull request audits awaiting import after the worker recovered.
Confirmed three prepared attempts and matching checkouts. Began reviewing the saved pull request revisions.
Imported three verified reports with eight findings. Each original revision has one matching GitHub audit check. No audit is waiting for import.

chips.title: Prove the full audit baseline
chips.summary: Run one full repository audit and verify that a later pull request audit uses it as its comparison baseline.

evidence.message: The three completed pull request audits have no comparison baseline. The live store has no full audit.
Confirmed the worker is healthy and the repository has no baseline. Started the full audit and a pull request to verify its use.
The worker completed the scheduled full audit and selects it as the repository baseline. It covers all 117 concepts and records 32 findings.
